sentences.text:
Pranab Kumar Madhu & Anr vs Unknown on 6 June, 2023
06.06.2023.
21. Ct.No.28 as (Rejected) C.R.M. (Db) 2087 of 2023 In Re:- An application for bail under Section
439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Hemtabad P. S. Case No.41 of 2023 dated
02.03.2023 under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

In the matter of : Pranab Kumar Madhu & Anr.
... Petitioners.
Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, Ld. P.P., Mr. Aniket Mitra, Mrs. Debjani Sahu.
Heard the learned Advocates for the parties.
We have considered the materials on record.
Witnesses state that petitioners who are the in-laws of the victim housewife had administered poison to her.
In view of the aforesaid materials and gravity of offence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioners.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioners is rejected.

(Ajay Kumar Gupta,J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
